thought.text: I see the issue - there's a symlink at `/opt/areloria` pointing to `/root/opt/areloria`. Let me check:

reasoning_content:
The log shows it's still looking at `/opt/areloria/server/package.json` which still has type: module. But there's another issue - the path is wrong. Let me check if maybe there's an old copy or symlink at /opt/areloria.

Also the error says "file:///opt/areloria/server/dist/index.js" - but we fixed /root/opt/areloria. There's a symlink or different path.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check if /opt points to /root
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/")
print("=== /opt/ ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria 2>/dev/null || ls -la /opt/")
print("\n=== opt/areloria ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Check where PM2 is actually running from
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 show areloria | grep CWD")
print("\n=== PM2 CWD ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Fix /opt/areloria/server/package.json too
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '/\"type\": \"module\"/d' /opt/areloria/server/package.json 2>/dev/null || echo 'no /opt/areloria'")
print("\nFixed /opt/areloria if exists")

client.close()
PYEOF
